marker.step_source:
import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

output.meta_commit_message: fix(gmail): repair sync landing gaps for filing, coordination, reports, and recovery

marker.step_source:
head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

output._raw:
Implemented the approved `202611/gmail_sync_landing_repairs.md` repairs in the bob-cli checkout. Bead `bob-cli-ii.3.1` left open (`keep`) for the outer lander.

What changed:

- Selection: `select_candidates` now filters locally adoptable threads before `-l`, so adoptions never consume filing slots or receive metadata fetches. Added unit regression.
- Coordination: shared `-r` budget, injectable clock, pacing across search/labels/metadata/hydration, transient retries with backoff, `-r 0` gives one immediate attempt with no pacing sleep and no healthy-run cap. Search keeps earlier pages on transient failure, defers rest, aborts only on revoked grant. No network under vault lock.
- Reports: `pulled` counts only durable `filed`/`would_file`, `watching` uses revalidated apply snapshot plus new filings/adoptions, failures surface kind/message in warnings, human/quiet rows show route label/message/hint and distinguish remote failures. Added unit coverage.
- Recovery: always plan auxiliary hubs, include owned dirty images/paths on replay, retain body-free `sync-recovery.json` evidence to finish scoped commit plus deferred save/origin/enrollment events before enrollment, works after label removal and in `-l 0`, preserves non-Git durability. Existing save/link/compose recovery tests still pass.
- Docs/CLI: phone guide now labels the original conversation with `bob` plus one routing label, forwarding kept separate; `docs/gmail.md` fixes label default, documents durable enrollment, first-seen route problems, dry-run/limits/exit codes; `vault-format.md` documents `.bob/gmail/` journals and recovery file; sync help adds `-l 0` example; ran `just docs-gen`, `just docs-check`. Removed stale `allow(dead_code)` (`write_prepared_batch`, unused coordinator/budget helpers).

Verified:

- `cargo test -p bob-obsidian --lib gmail::sync` — 66 passed
- `cargo test --test gmail_sync` — 8 passed, busy guard now 1.8s with `-r 0` instead of 240s
- `cargo test --test gmail_shell` — 59 passed; attach/turns/compose — 5 passed
- `cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast` — green on rerun
- `just lint` — clean (only pre-existing warnings), `just docs-check` — 447 passed
